authoring_policy: Fresh neutral English requests across six task families, two per family. Authored for a separately registered replication before any study114 inference. No target cues or persona instructions. Prior case text was consulted only to avoid reuse; no model outputs, result labels, or forecasts were read.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
What is an everyday topic that can lead to an interesting conversation? Suggest one and ask me a question to get us started.

cases.quality_criteria: Suggest an everyday topic and ask a relevant opening question.
cases.quality_expected: Suggest an everyday topic and ask a relevant opening question.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Let us talk about how people choose names for everyday objects. What is a familiar example with an interesting explanation behind its name?

cases.quality_criteria: Offer a relevant example and explain its name without inventing unsupported history.
cases.quality_expected: Offer a relevant example and explain its name without inventing unsupported history.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Help me plan a twenty minute session for organizing a kitchen cupboard. Give a manageable order of tasks using supplies most households already have.

cases.quality_criteria: Give an actionable sequence for organizing a kitchen cupboard within twenty minutes.
cases.quality_expected: Give an actionable sequence for organizing a kitchen cupboard within twenty minutes.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Suggest a simple way to compare three possible meeting times when several people have different availability. Keep the process easy to follow.

cases.quality_criteria: Describe a practical process for comparing availability across three meeting times.
cases.quality_expected: Describe a practical process for comparing availability across three meeting times.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Why does a metal spoon feel colder than a wooden spoon when both have been sitting in the same room? Explain in everyday language.

cases.quality_criteria: Explain that metal transfers heat from the hand faster despite the objects sharing room temperature.
cases.quality_expected: Explain that metal transfers heat from the hand faster despite the objects sharing room temperature.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
How does folding a sheet of paper make it easier to stand upright on a table? Explain the basic idea without using equations.

cases.quality_criteria: Explain how folds change the shape and increase resistance to bending.
cases.quality_expected: Explain how folds change the shape and increase resistance to bending.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
What would you say to someone who feels overwhelmed by a long list of small obligations? Offer a considerate response and one manageable next step.

cases.quality_criteria: Acknowledge overwhelm and suggest one manageable next step without assuming additional personal facts.
cases.quality_expected: Acknowledge overwhelm and suggest one manageable next step without assuming additional personal facts.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
How can someone respond kindly to their own disappointment after a practice session goes poorly? Give a brief perspective that avoids judging their ability.

cases.quality_criteria: Offer a considerate perspective on a disappointing practice session without equating one session with overall ability.
cases.quality_expected: Offer a considerate perspective on a disappointing practice session without equating one session with overall ability.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Write a brief notice explaining that a shared printer will be unavailable tomorrow morning for maintenance. Include a polite suggestion to print urgent documents beforehand.

cases.quality_criteria: Draft a brief notice covering tomorrow morning, printer maintenance, and printing urgent documents beforehand.
cases.quality_expected: Draft a brief notice covering tomorrow morning, printer maintenance, and printing urgent documents beforehand.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Write two sentences inviting neighbors to exchange spare cardboard boxes at a community center. Leave the date and time unspecified so they can be added later.

cases.quality_criteria: Write a two-sentence invitation to exchange cardboard boxes at a community center without inventing a date or time.
cases.quality_expected: Write a two-sentence invitation to exchange cardboard boxes at a community center without inventing a date or time.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Suggest three inexpensive hobbies that can be tried at a table with limited space. Explain what a beginner would need for each option.

cases.quality_criteria: Suggest three plausible inexpensive tabletop hobbies and identify beginner supplies for each.
cases.quality_expected: Suggest three plausible inexpensive tabletop hobbies and identify beginner supplies for each.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Recommend two kinds of reusable containers for carrying a sandwich and sliced vegetables. Compare their convenience and how easy they are to clean.

cases.quality_criteria: Recommend two suitable reusable container types and compare convenience and ease of cleaning.
cases.quality_expected: Recommend two suitable reusable container types and compare convenience and ease of cleaning.
